name: zvid_pack_color_00rrggbb
description: zVid_PackColor00RRGGBB packs a 00RRGGBB color value into the active 16-bit pixel format using the global pixel-pack masks and shifts.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x4a6ca0 has no warnings or tags and extracts red from bits 0..7, green from bits 8..15, and blue from bits 16..23 before applying the active pixel-pack masks and shifts.
The native zVideo color-pack smoke verifies 00RRGGBB packing under a 5:6:5 pixel format.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4a6ca0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
